title: 국회의원수당 등에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:1:0:00001:part:1/1
full_text: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of these Rules is to prescribe matters concerning the adjustment of allowances and expenses for legislative activities paid to members of the National Assembly and matters concerning their travel expenses, as delegated by the Act on Assistants to Members of the National Assembly and Allowances, etc. (hereinafter referred to as the "Act").
